_about: Hand-written, from the spells' own texts in the code (base values, no upgrades). description: what the spell does; tags: the chips under the name (to be filled in by the user).

Blood Frenzy.description: Increase the production of all Evil buildings for its duration.

Brainwave.description: Increase the production of all buildings by a cumulative percentage per second, based on time passed.

Call to Arms.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on buildings built.

Combo Strike.description: Increase the production of all buildings by a progressively higher value as you continue casting this spell. The duration of the spell cannot be modified.

Diamond Pickaxe.description: Increase clicking reward based on Excavation depth and increase your Faction Coin find chance.

Fairy Chanting.description: Increase the production of Farms, Inns and Blacksmiths based on the amounts built.

Gem Grinder.description: Multiplicatively increase the production bonus from Gems.

Goblin's Greed.description: Instantly produce Faction Coins based on Gems owned.

God's Hand.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on your Mana Regeneration. The duration increases with time spent as Good in this Reincarnation.

Grand Balance.description: Increase the production of your least productive buildings based on the three most built ones.

Hellfire Blast.description: Increase the production of Evil Fortresses based on your amount of trophies.

Lightning Strike.description: The production of a random building is increased based on the amount of Iron Strongholds owned.

Moon Blessing.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on clicks made in this Reincarnation. Autoclick 15 times per second.

Night Time.description: The production of assistants is increased based on Necropolises owned.

Spiritual Surge.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on Reincarnations made.

Tax Collection.description: Instantly gain some seconds' worth of coin production from buildings and assistants.

Hailstorm.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on Hailstorm activity time. The bonus increases progressively over the duration of the spell.

Heatwave.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on spells cast in this Era.

Dragon's Breath.description: Activates one of six effects at random: Red, Green, Blue, White, Black or Yellow.

Cannibalize.description: Increase Faction Coin find chance based on the total amount of Bones collected and Reincarnations made.

Shadow Embrace.description: Increase the size of your assistant army based on Reincarnations made. Increases progressively as you continue casting this spell.

Wail of the Banshee.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on mana produced in this Era and Reincarnations made.

Temporal Flux.description: Increase the production of Unique Buildings based on time spent in this Era.

All Creation.description: Increase the production of all buildings based on your Mana Regeneration.

Maelstrom.description: Increase the production of two random buildings based on one of these stats in this Era, chosen at random: mana produced, trophies unlocked, Faction Coins found or amount of assistants.

Infinite Spiral.description: Increase the production of all buildings by a percentage each second, up to its maximum duration. Temporarily increase assistants based on Maximum Mana.

Limited Wish.description: Provide a random effect based on your chosen alignment. The duration of the spell cannot be modified, but its cost decreases by 1% per minute up to 1 hour, then it resets. Its power increases as you continue casting this spell.

Precognition.description: Buildings, Assistants, Royal Exchanges, Spells cast and Clicks count more, based on mana produced in this Era.

Catalyst.description: Activates two random Vanilla or base alignment spells.

Chaos Madness.description: Grants the effect of a random lineage, with the level of your highest lineage.

Twisting Nether.description: Lineage levels count more for its duration.
